description.text: Submodel for kinematics control of ABB IRB 4600-4-255 robot compatible with SCL code
Inputs: Commands and motion setpoints, written by HMI/SCADA/digital twin, read by the SCL logic
Motion mode selection: TRUE = Auto routine, FALSE = Manual point-to-point (BOOL)
Motion velocity used for MC_MoveDirectAbsolute calls (LReal) - mm/s
Intermediate return/park position used after every stacking cycle [X,Y,Z,A] (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Approach point 1 of the pickup sequence [X,Y,Z,A] (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Approach point 2 of the pickup sequence [X,Y,Z,A] (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Approach point 3 of the pickup sequence [X,Y,Z,A] (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Manual-mode trigger: move to maintenance position (BOOL)
Manual-mode trigger: move to home position (BOOL)
Auto-mode trigger: run the left stacking routine (BOOL)
Auto-mode trigger: run the right stacking routine (BOOL)
Sequence of 6 points for the left stacking station (each Array[1..4] of LReal, stored as 6 separate DB tags StackingLeft_Points1..StackingLeft_Points6)
Sequence of 6 points for the right stacking station (each Array[1..4] of LReal, stored as 6 separate DB tags StackingRight_Points1..StackingRight_Points6)
User access level: 0 = External (read-only), 1 = Operator, 2 = Maintenance Manager (Int)
Outputs: Feedback and status values written back by the SCL logic
Actual TCP position [X,Y,Z,A], fed from "Kinematics_1".Tcp.x/y/z/a (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Dynamic speed per axis (Array[1..4] of LReal) - mm/s
Dynamic torque per axis (Array[1..4] of LReal) - N.m
Axis limits for each joint [Min, Max] (Array[1..4, 1..2] of LReal)
Power consumption per axis (Array[1..4] of LReal) - Watts

RobotDB_A1..RobotDB_A4 are of type PD_TEL3 (PROFIdrive telegram 3 UDT) in the Static DB. They are complex structured drive-telegram tags, not simple values, and are intentionally left out of this submodel. Model them in a dedicated PROFIdrive submodel if the digital twin needs direct access to raw drive telegram data.
Submodel for mapping all elements to actual OPC UA node addresses
Actual OPC UA Node IDs for each input variable
Actual OPC UA Node IDs for each output variable
